component.name: UU Remote for Linux
component.summary: Unofficial Linux controller compatibility wrapper for UU Remote

description.p: Runs the official Windows UU Remote client in a dedicated Wine prefix for controller-side validation on Linux.
This is not a native client and does not claim Linux host support.
Rename the public application to UU Remote for Linux and make validation portable to headless CI runners.
Forward Super+Space to the focused Wine remote-control window by temporarily releasing conflicting GNOME and IBus shortcuts, with exact focus-loss and crash recovery.
Route upstream automatic updates through a hash-gated transaction that preserves compatibility DLLs and rolls back failed bridge validation.
Keep UU Server and Healthd attached to user-level systemd transient services so Wine cannot lose them when the launcher exits.
Add native Ethernet Wake-on-LAN configuration and a version-locked UU network-card capability bridge.
Bridge the upstream prevent-sleep switch to a native systemd-logind sleep and idle inhibitor.
Poll live Wine auto-start state while the prefix server is active, without restarting Wine after an explicit stop.
Synchronize the upstream Windows auto-start switch to XDG autostart using the live Wine registry state.
Bridge the upstream Windows auto-start setting to a managed XDG login autostart entry.
Add automatic CPU/GPU discovery, a graphical decoder selector, runtime NVDEC capability queries, and NVIDIA multi-GPU binding.
Add an opt-in NVIDIA NVDEC to D3D11 CPU-bounce compatibility bridge.
Prevent persistent Wine processes from inheriting the operation lock.
